					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m194_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$ }
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_x_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_x_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_x_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_x_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_x_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_x_revision

			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_m194_receipt_subject

			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_m194_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_m194_receipt_state

			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = var:zg361_ip_m194_choice
			OPERATION_ID = 194
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_result_score value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m194_choice = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m194_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m194_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_target_relief_hours value = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_unrelieved_hours value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m194_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_target_relief_hours value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_unrelieved_hours value = 10 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_object_type_code value = 194 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_object_workload_relief value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 194 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_consumer_contract value = 194 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_resource_capacity value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_resource_target value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_object_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_debt_type_code value = 194 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 194 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_debt_consumer_contract value = 194 }

			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7194 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m194_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_last_consumer value = 194 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m194_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_verified_compensation value = var:zg361_ip_m193_pay_gold }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_consumer_grant_target_relief value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m194_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_evidence_n add = 1 }

		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_199_choice = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_choice value = 3 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner = { is_ai = yes is_at_war = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_choice value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner = { is_ai = yes stewardship < 10 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_choice value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_ip_m199_choice < 3
			NOT = {
always = yes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_choice value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_prerequisite_deferred value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_m199_done_owner has_variable = zg361_ip_m199_done_subject has_variable = zg361_ip_m199_done_cycle has_variable = zg361_ip_m199_done_case has_variable = zg361_ip_m199_done_state }
				OR = {
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m199_done_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m199_done_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m199_done_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m199_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m199_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$ }
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_x_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_x_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_x_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_x_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_x_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_x_revision
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_x_active
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_x_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_x_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_x_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_x_last_choice

			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_m199_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_m199_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_m199_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_m199_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ip_m199_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = var:zg361_ip_m199_choice
			OPERATION_ID = 199
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_result_score value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m199_choice = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m199_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m199_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_prevention_credit value = 15 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_observation_days value = 90 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m199_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_prevention_credit value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_observation_days value = 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_object_type_code value = 199 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_object_prevention_observation value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 199 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_consumer_contract value = 199 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_resource_observation value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_resource_credit value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_object_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_debt_type_code value = 199 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 199 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_debt_consumer_contract value = 199 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7199 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m199_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_last_consumer value = 199 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m199_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_observation_window_frozen value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_prevention_credit_pending value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_ip_m199_observation_days > 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_prevention_credit_pending value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_credit_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_consumer_award_prevention_credit value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m199_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 201 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_consumer_contract value = 201 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_resource_timeline value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_debt_type_code value = 201 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 201 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_debt_consumer_contract value = 201 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7201 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m201_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_last_consumer value = 201 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m201_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_timeline_revision value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_timeline_deletions value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_append_only_enforced value = var:zg361_ip_m201_timeline_locked }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_consumer_freeze_timeline value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }

				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}

# 202: one receipted A/B/C operation in X stage 6.
zg361_ip_m202_apply_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m202_choice value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner = { has_variable = zg361_mechanism_202_choice } }

		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_202_choice = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m202_choice value = 3 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner = { is_ai = yes is_at_war = yes } }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner = { is_ai = yes stewardship < 10 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m202_choice value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_ip_m202_choice < 3
			NOT = {
trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m201_business_object_created

				OR = {
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m202_done_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m202_done_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m202_done_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }

			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m203_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7203 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m203_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_last_consumer value = 203 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m203_business_object_created = 1 }
		var:zg361_case_x_owner = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zg361_ip_incident_repeat_n } } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_incident_repeat_n value = 0 } }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_incident_repeat_n add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m203_action_items_used value = var:zg361_ip_m202_action_items }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m203_consumer_assign_repeat_liability value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m203_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m203_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m203_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m203_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }

			}
		}
	}

# 204: one receipted A/B/C operation in X stage 7.
zg361_ip_m204_apply_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_choice value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner = { has_variable = zg361_mechanism_204_choice } }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_204_choice = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_choice value = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_204_choice = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_choice value = 3 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner = { is_ai = yes is_at_war = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_choice value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner = { is_ai = yes stewardship < 10 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_choice value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_ip_m204_choice < 3
			NOT = {
trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m196_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m196_object_type_code
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m196_object_incident_severity_assessment

				has_variable = zg361_ip_m196_object_case
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m196_object_state
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m196_consumer_contract
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m196_object_consumed
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m196_consumer_classify_severity
			}
			var:zg361_ip_m196_business_object_created = 1
			var:zg361_ip_m196_object_type_code = 196
			var:zg361_ip_m196_object_incident_severity_assessment = 1
			var:zg361_ip_m196_object_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_ip_m196_object_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$

			var:zg361_ip_m196_object_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_ip_m196_object_state = 2

			var:zg361_ip_m196_object_consumed = 1
			var:zg361_ip_m196_consumer_classify_severity = 1
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_choice value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_prerequisite_deferred value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_m204_done_owner has_variable = zg361_ip_m204_done_subject has_variable = zg361_ip_m204_done_cycle has_variable = zg361_ip_m204_done_case has_variable = zg361_ip_m204_done_state }
				OR = {
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m204_done_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m204_done_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m204_done_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m204_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m204_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$ }
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_x_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_x_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_x_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_x_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_x_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_x_revision
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_x_active
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_x_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_x_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_x_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_x_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ip_m204_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_m204_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_m204_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_m204_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_m204_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ip_m204_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = var:zg361_ip_m204_choice
			OPERATION_ID = 204
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_result_score value = 4 }

			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m204_choice = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m204_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m204_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_reliability_spend value = 40 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_release_gate value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m204_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_reliability_spend value = 30 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_release_gate value = 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_business_object_created value = 1 }

			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }

		if = { limit = { var:zg361_ip_m204_budget_remaining <= 60 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_release_frozen value = 1 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_consumer_consume_reliability_budget value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }

	}

					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m206_done_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m206_done_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m206_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m206_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$ }
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_y_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_y_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_y_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_y_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_y_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_y_revision
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_y_active
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_y_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_y_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_y_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_y_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ip_m206_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_m206_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_m206_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_m206_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_m206_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ip_m206_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = var:zg361_ip_m206_choice
			OPERATION_ID = 206
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_result_score value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m206_choice = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m206_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m206_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_principal value = 20 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_interest value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_original_owner_visible value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m206_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_principal value = 30 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_interest value = 8 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_original_owner_visible value = 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_object_type_code value = 206 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_object_technical_debt_item value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 206 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_consumer_contract value = 206 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_resource_technical_debt value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_type_code value = 206 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 206 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_consumer_contract value = 206 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7206 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m206_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_last_consumer value = 206 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m206_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_outstanding_debt value = { value = var:zg361_ip_m206_debt_principal add = var:zg361_ip_m206_debt_interest } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_consumer_register_debt value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m206_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_y_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_y_revision
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_y_active
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_y_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_y_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_y_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_y_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ip_m208_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_m208_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_m208_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_m208_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_m208_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ip_m208_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = var:zg361_ip_m208_choice
			OPERATION_ID = 208
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_result_score value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m208_choice = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m208_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m208_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_repair_route value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_repair_hours value = 20 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_repayment value = 20 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m208_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_repair_route value = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_repair_hours value = 30 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_repayment value = 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_object_type_code value = 208 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_object_repair_route_plan value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 208 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_consumer_contract value = 208 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_resource_capacity value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_resource_technical_debt value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_object_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_type_code value = 208 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 208 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_consumer_contract value = 208 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7208 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m208_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_last_consumer value = 208 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m208_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_after_repayment value = { value = var:zg361_ip_m206_outstanding_debt subtract = var:zg361_ip_m208_debt_repayment max = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_budget_used value = var:zg361_ip_m207_debt_budget_hours }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_consumer_choose_repair_route value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m208_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 209: one receipted A/B/C operation in Y stage 2.
zg361_ip_m209_apply_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_choice value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_y_owner = { has_variable = zg361_mechanism_209_choice } }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_y_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_209_choice = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_choice value = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_y_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_209_choice = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_choice value = 3 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_y_owner = { is_ai = yes is_at_war = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_choice value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_y_owner = { is_ai = yes stewardship < 10 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_choice value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_ip_m209_choice < 3
			NOT = {
always = yes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_choice value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_prerequisite_deferred value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_m209_done_owner has_variable = zg361_ip_m209_done_subject has_variable = zg361_ip_m209_done_cycle has_variable = zg361_ip_m209_done_case has_variable = zg361_ip_m209_done_state }
				OR = {
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m209_done_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m209_done_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m209_done_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m209_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m209_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$ }
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_y_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_y_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_y_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_y_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_y_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_y_revision
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_y_active
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_y_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_y_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_y_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_y_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ip_m209_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_m209_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_m209_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_m209_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_m209_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ip_m209_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = var:zg361_ip_m209_choice
			OPERATION_ID = 209
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_result_score value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m209_choice = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m209_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m209_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_hazard_pay_gold value = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_hazard_days value = 365 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_hazard_debt value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m209_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_hazard_pay_gold value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_hazard_days value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_hazard_debt value = 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_object_type_code value = 209 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_object_hazard_allowance_claim value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 209 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_consumer_contract value = 209 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_resource_treasury value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_resource_capacity value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_object_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_debt_type_code value = 209 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 209 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_debt_consumer_contract value = 209 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7209 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m209_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_last_consumer value = 209 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m209_business_object_created = 1 }
		# Hazard pay uses the same six-plus-four dual-payer atomic precheck.
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_funded value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_ledger_status value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m209_choice = 1 var:zg361_case_y_owner = { government_has_flag = government_has_treasury treasury >= 6 gold >= 4 } }
			var:zg361_case_y_owner = { remove_treasury = 6 remove_short_term_gold = 4 }
			add_gold = 10
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_treasury_paid value = 6 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_personal_paid value = 4 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_recipient_credit value = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_funded value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_ledger_status value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_ip_m209_choice = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_hazard_debt value = 10 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_ledger_status value = 3 } change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_score_delta add = -4 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_ip_m209_choice = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_ledger_status value = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_consumer_pay_hazard_allowance value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m209_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_m213_done_owner has_variable = zg361_ip_m213_done_subject has_variable = zg361_ip_m213_done_cycle has_variable = zg361_ip_m213_done_case has_variable = zg361_ip_m213_done_state }
				OR = {
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m213_done_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m213_done_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m213_done_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m213_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m213_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$ }
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_y_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_y_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_y_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_y_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_y_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_y_revision
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_y_active
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_y_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_y_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_y_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_y_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ip_m213_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_m213_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_m213_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_m213_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_m213_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ip_m213_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = var:zg361_ip_m213_choice
			OPERATION_ID = 213
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_result_score value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m213_choice = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m213_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m213_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_validated_findings value = 4 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_review_hours value = 5 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_blocking_hours value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m213_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_validated_findings value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_review_hours value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_blocking_hours value = 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_object_type_code value = 213 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_object_review_contribution value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 213 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_consumer_contract value = 213 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_resource_capacity value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_resource_credit value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_debt_type_code value = 213 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 213 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_debt_consumer_contract value = 213 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7213 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m213_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_last_consumer value = 213 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m213_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_review_credit value = var:zg361_ip_m213_validated_findings }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_comment_count_used value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_review_capacity_used value = { value = var:zg361_ip_m213_review_hours add = var:zg361_ip_m213_blocking_hours } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_consumer_record_review_credit value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m213_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m215_choice = 2 }

		}
		else_if = {

			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m215_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_legacy_retired value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_hc_released value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_necessity_appeal value = 1 }
			if = {

				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_legacy_retired value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_hc_released value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_necessity_appeal value = 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_object_type_code value = 215 }

			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 215 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_consumer_contract value = 215 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_resource_capacity value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_resource_hc value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_object_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m215_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }

		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m215_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_evidence_n add = 1 }

			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7217 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m217_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_last_consumer value = 217 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m217_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m217_adoption_policy_frozen value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m217_exception_receipt_required value = var:zg361_ip_m217_approved_exception }

					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m217_consumer_decide_adoption value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m217_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m217_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m217_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }

				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m219_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 220: one receipted A/B/C operation in Z stage 2.
zg361_ip_m220_apply_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_choice value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_z_owner = { has_variable = zg361_mechanism_220_choice } }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_z_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_220_choice = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_choice value = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_z_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_220_choice = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_choice value = 3 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_z_owner = { is_ai = yes is_at_war = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_choice value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_z_owner = { is_ai = yes stewardship < 10 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_choice value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_ip_m220_choice < 3
			NOT = {
trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m219_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m219_object_type_code
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m219_object_platform_value_snapshot
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m219_object_owner
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m219_object_subject
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m219_object_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m219_object_case
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m219_object_state
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m219_consumer_contract
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m219_object_consumed
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m219_consumer_freeze_value_metrics
			}
			var:zg361_ip_m219_business_object_created = 1
			var:zg361_ip_m219_object_type_code = 219
			var:zg361_ip_m219_object_platform_value_snapshot = 1
			var:zg361_ip_m219_object_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_ip_m219_object_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_ip_m219_object_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_ip_m219_object_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_ip_m219_object_state = 1
			var:zg361_ip_m219_consumer_contract = 219
			var:zg361_ip_m219_object_consumed = 1
			var:zg361_ip_m219_consumer_freeze_value_metrics = 1
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_choice value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_prerequisite_deferred value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_m220_done_owner has_variable = zg361_ip_m220_done_subject has_variable = zg361_ip_m220_done_cycle has_variable = zg361_ip_m220_done_case has_variable = zg361_ip_m220_done_state }
				OR = {
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m220_done_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m220_done_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m220_done_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m220_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m220_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$ }
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_z_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_z_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_z_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_z_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_z_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_z_revision
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_z_active
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_z_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_z_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_z_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_z_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ip_m220_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_m220_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_m220_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_m220_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_m220_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ip_m220_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = var:zg361_ip_m220_choice
			OPERATION_ID = 220
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_result_score value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m220_choice = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m220_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m220_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_total_cost value = 20 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_treasury_cost value = 12 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_personal_cost value = 8 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_showback_cost value = 20 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m220_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_total_cost value = 20 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_treasury_cost value = 18 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_personal_cost value = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_showback_cost value = 20 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_type_code value = 220 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_platform_chargeback_ledger value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 220 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_consumer_contract value = 220 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_resource_treasury value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_resource_chargeback value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_type_code value = 220 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 220 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_consumer_contract value = 220 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7220 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m220_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_last_consumer value = 220 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m220_business_object_created = 1 }
		# Platform settlement also debits organization and manager atomically.
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_funded value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_ledger_status value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:zg361_ip_m220_total_cost > 0
				var:zg361_case_z_owner = {
					government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
					treasury >= var:zg361_ip_m220_treasury_cost
					gold >= var:zg361_ip_m220_personal_cost
				}
			}
			var:zg361_case_z_owner = { remove_treasury = var:zg361_ip_m220_treasury_cost remove_short_term_gold = var:zg361_ip_m220_personal_cost }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_treasury_paid value = var:zg361_ip_m220_treasury_cost }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_personal_paid value = var:zg361_ip_m220_personal_cost }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_paid_total value = var:zg361_ip_m220_total_cost }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_funded value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_ledger_status value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m220_total_cost > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_cost_debt value = var:zg361_ip_m220_total_cost }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_ledger_status value = 3 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_score_delta add = -4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m220_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_cost_debt value = var:zg361_ip_m220_showback_cost }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_ledger_status value = 3 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_value_metric_used value = var:zg361_ip_m219_net_value }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_consumer_charge_platform_cost value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

				OR = {

					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m221_done_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }

					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m221_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m221_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$ }
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_z_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_z_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_z_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_z_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_z_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_z_revision
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_z_active
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_z_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_z_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_z_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_z_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ip_m221_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_m221_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_m221_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_m221_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_m221_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ip_m221_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = var:zg361_ip_m221_choice
			OPERATION_ID = 221
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_result_score value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m221_choice = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m221_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m221_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_platform_share value = 50 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_user_share value = 30 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_reform_share value = 20 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_migration_hours value = 30 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m221_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_platform_share value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_user_share value = 100 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_reform_share value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_migration_hours value = 20 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_type_code value = 221 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_migration_cost_allocation value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 221 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_consumer_contract value = 221 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_resource_platform_capacity value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_resource_user_capacity value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_resource_reform_capacity value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_type_code value = 221 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 221 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_consumer_contract value = 221 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7221 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m221_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_last_consumer value = 221 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m221_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_share_check value = { value = var:zg361_ip_m221_platform_share add = var:zg361_ip_m221_user_share add = var:zg361_ip_m221_reform_share } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_cost_receipt_used value = var:zg361_ip_m220_funded }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_consumer_allocate_migration_cost value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }

# 222: one receipted A/B/C operation in Z stage 3.
zg361_ip_m222_apply_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_choice value = 1 }

		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_z_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_222_choice = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_choice value = 3 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_z_owner = { is_ai = yes is_at_war = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_choice value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_z_owner = { is_ai = yes stewardship < 10 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_choice value = 2 }
	}
	if = {

			var:zg361_ip_m222_choice < 3
			NOT = {

				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_m222_done_owner has_variable = zg361_ip_m222_done_subject has_variable = zg361_ip_m222_done_cycle has_variable = zg361_ip_m222_done_case has_variable = zg361_ip_m222_done_state }

			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_z_subject

			var:zg361_ip_m223_object_duplicate_solution_scan = 1

			var:zg361_ip_m223_object_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_ip_m223_object_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_ip_m223_object_state = 3
			var:zg361_ip_m223_consumer_contract = 223
			var:zg361_ip_m223_object_consumed = 1
			var:zg361_ip_m223_consumer_record_duplicate_scan = 1
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_choice value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_prerequisite_deferred value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_m224_done_owner has_variable = zg361_ip_m224_done_subject has_variable = zg361_ip_m224_done_cycle has_variable = zg361_ip_m224_done_case has_variable = zg361_ip_m224_done_state }

					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m224_done_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }

					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m224_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m224_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$ }
				}
			}

			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_z_subject

			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ip_m224_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$

			OPERATION_ID = 224
		}

			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }

				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_result_score value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m224_choice = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m224_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m224_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_winner_code value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_loser_credit value = 40 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_rubric_frozen value = 1 }

				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m224_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_winner_code value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_loser_credit value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_rubric_frozen value = 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_business_object_created value = 1 }

			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 224 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_consumer_contract value = 224 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_resource_platform_capacity value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_resource_credit value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_debt_type_code value = 224 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 224 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_debt_consumer_contract value = 224 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7224 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m224_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_last_consumer value = 224 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m224_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_scan_receipt_used value = var:zg361_ip_m223_scan_complete }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_consumer_merge_solutions value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m224_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}

			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ip_m226_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_m226_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_m226_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_m226_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_m226_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ip_m226_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = var:zg361_ip_m226_choice
			OPERATION_ID = 226
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_result_score value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m226_choice = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m226_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m226_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_accepted_submissions value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_contributor_credit value = 60 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_maintainer_credit value = 40 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m226_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_accepted_submissions value = 5 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_contributor_credit value = 90 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_maintainer_credit value = 10 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_type_code value = 226 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_inner_source_submission value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 226 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_consumer_contract value = 226 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_resource_credit value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_resource_maintenance_capacity value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_type_code value = 226 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 226 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_consumer_contract value = 226 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7226 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m226_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_last_consumer value = 226 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m226_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_credit_check value = { value = var:zg361_ip_m226_contributor_credit add = var:zg361_ip_m226_maintainer_credit } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_fork_policy_used value = var:zg361_ip_m225_upstream_first }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_consumer_settle_inner_source value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}

# X closure: average all numbered outputs and affect the next review.
zg361_ip_finalize_x_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_case_x_state
			has_variable = zg361_case_x_active
			var:zg361_case_x_state = 8
			var:zg361_case_x_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_x_final_case }
				NOT = { var:zg361_ip_x_final_case = var:zg361_case_x_case_serial }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_final_score value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_x_evidence_n > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_final_score value = { value = var:zg361_ip_x_score_delta divide = var:zg361_ip_x_evidence_n round = yes max = 4 min = -4 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_kpi_value }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_kpi_value add = var:zg361_ip_x_final_score }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_kpi_value value = var:zg361_ip_x_final_score } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_final_owner value = var:zg361_case_x_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_final_subject value = var:zg361_case_x_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_final_cycle value = var:zg361_case_x_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_final_case value = var:zg361_case_x_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_final_state value = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_final_revision value = var:zg361_case_x_revision }
		save_scope_as = zg361_ip_result_subject
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner = { is_alive = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:zg361_case_x_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.190 } }
		}
		debug_log = "ZG361IP: X case closed and next-cycle KPI consumed"
	}
}

				DEADLINE_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_x_deadline_cycle
				DEADLINE_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_x_deadline_case
