				DEADLINE_DAYS_VAR = zg361_ip_x_deadline_days
				DEADLINE_PENDING_VAR = zg361_ip_x_deadline_pending
				DEADLINE_EXPIRED_VAR = zg361_ip_x_deadline_expired
				TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_x_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = var:zg361_case_x_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_x_cycle_serial
				TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_x_case_serial
				TICKET_STATE = 7
				DAYS = 90
				EVENT = zg361ip.107
			}
			}
		}
	}
}

# X stage 7: all operations settle before the sole transition.
zg361_ip_x_dispatch_07_effect = {
	zg361_ip_m204_apply_effect = {
		TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
		TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
		TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
		TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
		TICKET_STATE = 7
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_m204_done_owner has_variable = zg361_ip_m204_done_subject has_variable = zg361_ip_m204_done_cycle has_variable = zg361_ip_m204_done_case has_variable = zg361_ip_m204_done_state }
				var:zg361_ip_m204_done_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
				var:zg361_ip_m204_done_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				var:zg361_ip_m204_done_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				var:zg361_ip_m204_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$
				var:zg361_ip_m204_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		zg361_case_x_advance_07_effect = {
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			zg361_ip_finalize_x_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Subject-scope entry; ROOT must be the eligible direct manager.
zg361_ip_open_x_case_on_subject_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_x_final_score } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_previous_final_score value = var:zg361_ip_x_final_score } }
	zg361_case_x_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_score_delta value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_evidence_n value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_last_consumer value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zg361_ip_x_policy_debt } } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_policy_debt value = 0 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_deadline_pending value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_deadline_expired value = 0 }
			zg361_ip_x_dispatch_01_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_x_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = var:zg361_case_x_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_x_cycle_serial
				TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_x_case_serial
				TICKET_STATE = 1
			}
		}
	}
}

# Public integration entry. It grants no authority of its own: the shared open
# trigger still requires a landed celestial duke-or-higher direct manager.
zg361_ip_open_x_case_effect = {
	$SUBJECT$ = { zg361_ip_open_x_case_on_subject_effect = yes }
}

# Y closure: average all numbered outputs and affect the next review.
zg361_ip_finalize_y_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_case_y_state
			has_variable = zg361_case_y_active
			var:zg361_case_y_state = 6
			var:zg361_case_y_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_y_final_case }
				NOT = { var:zg361_ip_y_final_case = var:zg361_case_y_case_serial }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_final_score value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_y_evidence_n > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_final_score value = { value = var:zg361_ip_y_score_delta divide = var:zg361_ip_y_evidence_n round = yes max = 4 min = -4 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_kpi_value }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_kpi_value add = var:zg361_ip_y_final_score }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_kpi_value value = var:zg361_ip_y_final_score } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_final_owner value = var:zg361_case_y_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_final_subject value = var:zg361_case_y_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_final_cycle value = var:zg361_case_y_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_final_case value = var:zg361_case_y_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_final_state value = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_final_revision value = var:zg361_case_y_revision }
		save_scope_as = zg361_ip_result_subject
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_y_owner = { is_alive = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:zg361_case_y_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.290 } }
		}
		debug_log = "ZG361IP: Y case closed and next-cycle KPI consumed"
	}
}

# Y stage 1: all operations settle before the sole transition.
zg361_ip_y_dispatch_01_effect = {
	zg361_ip_m205_apply_effect = {
		TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
		TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
		TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$

	}
	zg361_ip_m206_apply_effect = {

		TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
		TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
		TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
		TICKET_STATE = 1
	}

	}
	if = {

				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_m205_done_owner has_variable = zg361_ip_m205_done_subject has_variable = zg361_ip_m205_done_cycle has_variable = zg361_ip_m205_done_case has_variable = zg361_ip_m205_done_state }

				var:zg361_ip_m205_done_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$

				var:zg361_ip_m205_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_m206_done_owner has_variable = zg361_ip_m206_done_subject has_variable = zg361_ip_m206_done_cycle has_variable = zg361_ip_m206_done_case has_variable = zg361_ip_m206_done_state }
				var:zg361_ip_m206_done_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
				var:zg361_ip_m206_done_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				var:zg361_ip_m206_done_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				var:zg361_ip_m206_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$
				var:zg361_ip_m206_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_m207_done_owner has_variable = zg361_ip_m207_done_subject has_variable = zg361_ip_m207_done_cycle has_variable = zg361_ip_m207_done_case has_variable = zg361_ip_m207_done_state }
				var:zg361_ip_m207_done_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
				var:zg361_ip_m207_done_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				var:zg361_ip_m207_done_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				var:zg361_ip_m207_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$
				var:zg361_ip_m207_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		zg361_case_y_advance_01_effect = {
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			zg361_case_kernel_schedule_deadline_effect = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_y_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_y_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_y_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_y_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_y_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_y_active
				DEADLINE_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ip_y_deadline_owner
				DEADLINE_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_y_deadline_subject
				DEADLINE_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_y_deadline_cycle
				DEADLINE_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_y_deadline_case
				DEADLINE_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_y_deadline_state
				DEADLINE_DAYS_VAR = zg361_ip_y_deadline_days
				DEADLINE_PENDING_VAR = zg361_ip_y_deadline_pending
				DEADLINE_EXPIRED_VAR = zg361_ip_y_deadline_expired
				TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_y_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = var:zg361_case_y_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_y_cycle_serial
				TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_y_case_serial
				TICKET_STATE = 2
				DAYS = 30
				EVENT = zg361ip.202
			}

# Subject-scope entry; ROOT must be the eligible direct manager.
zg361_ip_open_y_case_on_subject_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_y_final_score } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_previous_final_score value = var:zg361_ip_y_final_score } }
	zg361_case_y_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_score_delta value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_evidence_n value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_last_consumer value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zg361_ip_y_policy_debt } } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_policy_debt value = 0 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_deadline_pending value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_deadline_expired value = 0 }
			zg361_ip_y_dispatch_01_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_y_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = var:zg361_case_y_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_y_cycle_serial
				TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_y_case_serial
				TICKET_STATE = 1
			}
		}
	}
}

# Public integration entry. It grants no authority of its own: the shared open
# trigger still requires a landed celestial duke-or-higher direct manager.
zg361_ip_open_y_case_effect = {
	$SUBJECT$ = { zg361_ip_open_y_case_on_subject_effect = yes }
}

# Z closure: average all numbered outputs and affect the next review.
zg361_ip_finalize_z_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_case_z_state
			has_variable = zg361_case_z_active
			var:zg361_case_z_state = 6
			var:zg361_case_z_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_z_final_case }
				NOT = { var:zg361_ip_z_final_case = var:zg361_case_z_case_serial }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_final_score value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_z_evidence_n > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_final_score value = { value = var:zg361_ip_z_score_delta divide = var:zg361_ip_z_evidence_n round = yes max = 4 min = -4 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_kpi_value }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_kpi_value add = var:zg361_ip_z_final_score }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_kpi_value value = var:zg361_ip_z_final_score } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_final_owner value = var:zg361_case_z_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_final_subject value = var:zg361_case_z_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_final_cycle value = var:zg361_case_z_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_final_case value = var:zg361_case_z_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_final_state value = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_final_revision value = var:zg361_case_z_revision }
		save_scope_as = zg361_ip_result_subject
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_z_owner = { is_alive = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:zg361_case_z_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.390 } }
		}
		debug_log = "ZG361IP: Z case closed and next-cycle KPI consumed"
	}
}

		TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_z_timeline_serial
		FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_z_feedback_revision
		DEADLINE_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ip_z_deadline_owner
		DEADLINE_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_z_deadline_subject
		DEADLINE_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_z_deadline_cycle
		DEADLINE_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_z_deadline_case
		DEADLINE_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_z_deadline_state
		DEADLINE_PENDING_VAR = zg361_ip_z_deadline_pending
		DEADLINE_EXPIRED_VAR = zg361_ip_z_deadline_expired
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			zg361_ip_z_dispatch_03_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_ip_z_deadline_owner
		TICKET_SUBJECT = var:zg361_ip_z_deadline_subject
		TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_ip_z_deadline_cycle
		TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_ip_z_deadline_case
		TICKET_STATE = 3
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_ip_z_due_04_effect = {
	zg361_case_kernel_expire_deadline_effect = {
		OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_z_owner
		SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_z_subject
		CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_z_cycle_serial
		CASE_VAR = zg361_case_z_case_serial
		STATE_VAR = zg361_case_z_state
		REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_z_revision
		ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_z_active
		TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_z_timeline_serial
		FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_z_feedback_revision

# Subject-scope entry; ROOT must be the eligible direct manager.
zg361_ip_open_z_case_on_subject_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_z_final_score } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_previous_final_score value = var:zg361_ip_z_final_score } }
	zg361_case_z_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_score_delta value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_evidence_n value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_last_consumer value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zg361_ip_z_policy_debt } } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_policy_debt value = 0 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_deadline_pending value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_deadline_expired value = 0 }
			zg361_ip_z_dispatch_01_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_z_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = var:zg361_case_z_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_z_cycle_serial
				TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_z_case_serial
				TICKET_STATE = 1
			}
		}
	}
}

# Public integration entry. It grants no authority of its own: the shared open
# trigger still requires a landed celestial duke-or-higher direct manager.
zg361_ip_open_z_case_effect = {
	$SUBJECT$ = { zg361_ip_open_z_case_on_subject_effect = yes }
}

# Single integration hook: open the three independent cases for one bounded
# direct assessed official. Counts/barons are valid subjects but never ROOT here.
zg361_ip_open_portfolio_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_game_rule = zg361_on
			zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
			has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			any_vassal = { zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_portfolio_cycle }
				NOT = { var:zg361_ip_portfolio_cycle = var:zg361_review_serial }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_portfolio_cycle value = var:zg361_review_serial }
		ordered_vassal = {
			limit = { zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes }
			order_by = stewardship
			zg361_ip_open_x_case_on_subject_effect = yes
			zg361_ip_open_y_case_on_subject_effect = yes
			zg361_ip_open_z_case_on_subject_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
